init.repoIntro: Snorkeling is a personalized customization project based on Wave Terminal upstream.
init.communityIntro: Get help, submit feature requests, report bugs, or just chat with fellow terminal enthusiasts.
init.telemetryIntro: Anonymous usage data helps us improve features you use.

noTelemetryStar.title: Telemetry Disabled ✓
noTelemetryStar.introLine1: No problem, we respect your privacy.
noTelemetryStar.introLine2: Snorkeling is a customized project based on Wave Terminal. If this customization is useful, starring the Snorkeling repository helps us keep maintaining it.

waveai.title: Wave AI
waveai.intro: Wave AI is your terminal assistant with context. I can read your terminal output, analyze widgets, read/write files, and help you solve problems faster.
waveai.toggleWithButton: Toggle the Wave AI panel with the <AiButton /> button in the header (top left)
waveai.shortcutIntro: Or use the keyboard shortcut <Shortcut /> to quickly toggle
waveai.apiKeyIntro: Bring your own API keys or run local models with Ollama, LM Studio, and other OpenAI-compatible providers

magnify.title: Magnify Blocks
magnify.intro1: Magnify any block to focus on what matters. Expand terminals, editors, and previews for a better view.
magnify.intro2: Use the magnify feature to work with complex outputs and large files more efficiently.
magnify.iconHint: You can also magnify a block by clicking on the <Icon /> icon in the block header.
magnify.shortcutHint: A quick <Shortcut /> to magnify and another <Shortcut /> to unmagnify

files.title: Viewing/Editing Files
files.intro: Wave can preview markdown, images, and video files on both local <Italic>and remote</Italic> machines.
files.viewHint: Use wsh view [filename] to preview files in Wave's graphical viewer
files.editHint: Use wsh edit [filename] to open config files or code files in Wave's graphical editor
files.remoteSummary: These commands work seamlessly on both local and remote machines, making it easy to view and edit files wherever they are.

durable.title: Durable SSH Sessions
durable.subtitle: SSH Sessions, Protected
durable.intro: Close your laptop, switch networks, restart Wave — your remote sessions keep running.
durable.preserve: Shell state, running programs, and terminal history are all preserved
durable.reconnect: Sessions automatically reconnect when your connection is restored
durable.buffer: Buffered output streams back in, never miss a line
durable.footnote: All the persistence of tmux, built into your terminal. Look for the shield icon to enable durability on any SSH session.

starAsk.title: Support open-source. Star Snorkeling. ⭐
starAsk.intro: Snorkeling is a custom project built on top of Wave Terminal upstream.
starAsk.intro2: If this customization is useful for your workflow, please star the Snorkeling repository.

upgradeMinor.title: Welcome to Wave v0.14!
upgradeMinor.intro1: Wave AI is your terminal assistant with full context. It can read your terminal output, analyze widgets, read and write files, and help you solve problems faster.
upgradeMinor.newInV013Detail: Wave AI now supports local models and bring-your-own-key! Use Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible provider.
upgradeMinor.newInV014Detail: Durable SSH sessions survive network drops, laptop sleep, and restarts — all without tmux or screen.
upgradeMinor.thanksLine: Thanks for being an early Wave adopter! ⭐
upgradeMinor.starPitch: A GitHub star shows your support for Wave (and open-source) and helps us reach more developers.
